args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The function docstring already specified banker's rounding per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_half_even to
fail (e.g. Decimal("2.665") rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
